name: Store review triage (BG)
description: Sort customer reviews of a Bulgarian online store by what the shop should do with them: thank the customer, fix a problem, look at both, or consider an idea.
guidelines:
Reviews come from Bulgarian review sites. Many end with a short list of pros and then a short list of cons, without headings.
category: the overall point of the review for the shop.
- compliment: the experience was good overall: fast delivery, good prices, polite staff, a good product. A small remark or a wish at the end does not change this, and neither does a short cons list when the text itself is positive.
- complaint: the experience was bad: an order not delivered or cancelled, goods shown as in stock that are not, a wrong price or fee, a faulty product, rude or silent staff. There is little or no real praise.
- mixed: the reviewer gives real weight to both sides: something went well and something went wrong for them ("friendly staff, but the parcel came three days late").
- suggestion: the main point is advice to the shop about what to change or add ("update the stock more often", "list the dimensions of every product", "add card payment"), more than a verdict on one experience.
guidelines_note: Written by Claude Code after reading the train split of the dataset (never the test split); not written by a human.
